Six-file implementation: additive ArtifactRole.ResultPayload (result-payload, binary packed-array with required layout) and ManifestRelation.ResultPayloadOf (result-payload-of, owner study-result@2), at least one owner per payload; ResultManifest.packed emits deterministic names and established participant chunks. Registered result codecs and ArtifactDecoders.resultWithPayloads materialize packed archives using only related verified chunks; Delegating forwards it. Resolver verifies exact references and refuses extraneous chunks after ordinary byte and completed-result checks. Recording roles unchanged; no new schema version or diagnostic cases. New ResultPayloadManifestSuite and docs/RESULT_PAYLOAD_MANIFEST.md.

PASS195 checks: JVM91 + JS91 selected codec tests (12 new payload conformance/adversarial tests each, frozen manifest fixtures, recording/temporal/report graphs, density25, diagnostics7), docs3, JVM frozen resource resolution10. rootJVM/rootJS Test/compile with GITHUB_ACTIONS=true, headerCheckAll/scalafmtCheckAll/scalafmtSbtCheck/githubWorkflowCheck/checkBoundaries PASS. Logs/meta under /private/tmp/eyes4s-ui-e-manifest: slice-gate.log (tests185 and compiles passed, then workflow task was mistakenly scoped to rootJS and failed looking under .js); final-checks.log exit0 verifies both compiles and all checks from root; frozen-resource-check.log exit0 adds10. Earlier syntax/unused warnings and generator intentional rewrite refusal retained; no suppressed tests. frozen-fixtures.json proves both resource files and Scala fixture sources byte-identical to UI-E87a4bbab, pinned main and integration baseline.

Main integration conflicts: diagnostic table regenerated, codec pin113/34f298895e57e590 validated on both platforms; API inventory/evidence were selected from pinned main without hand-merging. They are explicitly stale for combined UI-E/S4 pending final re-recorded audit. No full audit, publishing consumer, main writes, merge/push or acceptance performed.

Scope: this is eager packed-result resolution. Recomputable archives have no payload relation and continue to require the explicit DensityArchiveCodec.recomputer; resolver refuses them, tested. No automatic recomputation, bounded execution, authenticity or manifest@2 claim. ReportOf still binds the exact canonical stored documents under existing UI-C rules. Shared ScientificManifest/ArtifactResolution edits coexist with SourceRef S3 in separate isolated branches per Fray36; final lead merge must reconcile additive roles/decorators.

Request independent review of this exact SHA, especially payload ownership/ref isolation, tamper refusal, preserved v1 bytes and decorator forwarding. S4 marked review, not complete; parent and earlier slice acceptance unchanged. Worktree clean except intentional local sbt workaround. No active jobs.
